text: Stop. Two hundred job applications and zero calls? An AI job agent can fix this.
Two hundred applications, Amma. Not one call!
Send the same resume to everyone! It is a sure shot! One will click!
That is the problem. Applicants per job have more than doubled since 2022, and ninety four percent of Indian professionals plan to use AI in their job search.
Kanna, work smarter. Use a job agent.
A job agent is an AI assistant that runs your job hunt in five steps.
One. It reads your resume, skills, salary and city. Two. Every morning, it scans job sites for new openings.
Three. It scores each job against your profile, and skips the weak matches. Four. It tailors your resume and cover letter for each job, using only your real experience.
Five. It tracks every application, reminds you to follow up, and preps you for the interview.
So it applies for me automatically?
No, kanna. You read and approve every application yourself.
Three rules. Never give it your passwords or OTPs. Never pay a placement fee to anyone who promises a job. And never let it invent experience you do not have.
Your salary is your biggest investment, kanna. Grow it.
